dct_creator_sm: City of Milwaukee City Clerk License Division
dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains 1,288 City of Milwaukee liquor-license records as of September 18, 2026. Fields describe license effective and expiration dates, corporate and trade names, licensees, premises addresses, license types, capacity, aldermanic and police districts, and tax keys. TAXKEY can be used to join licensed premises to the City of Milwaukee Parcel Polygons and Master Property File datasets. The source portal states that the dataset is refreshed nightly. The associated map service contains active licenses only.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
